lines.trans: He once said he avoids flour after heavy drinking yet ordered black-bean noodles—might he have drunk less than we thought?
You can never pin him down—basically he is not the type to stick to strict personal rules.
Then it is not a decisive clue after all.
Senior, does he really have to not remember?
If what you said was a lie, it should not matter even if he remembers.
and if by one chance in ten thousand you meant it, should he not remember it all the more?
Once you edit for a while you will learn—suppose someone says something and the other person gives zero reaction.
Then that remark has to be edited out.
Right now Joon-mo is showing zero reaction—he is treating me the exact same way as always.
If he remembers everything and still shows no reaction, does that not mean Joon-mo edited out those feelings?
So that is why you are hoping he cannot remember—for fear of having been edited out.
